script.cover_1: A short call to the cabin can ruin a junior's afternoon.
script.payoff: With no topic and no time, the junior guesses the worst.
script.caption: The walk to the cabin is longer when nobody says why. Send this to the manager who calls juniors in without a word.
script.lands: The junior may spend the whole walk guessing what went wrong, and hear nothing else.
script.better: Free at 4 pm for a quick chat about the deck? Nothing urgent.
script.why: It gives a time and a topic, so the walk is not spent guessing.
